hayley_sales: URGENT: Apollo deal moved to exec review. CTO says demo tomorrow needs p95 <150ms for 256-token gen. Also asked for SSO + a short reserved window. Need a one-paragraph note and a runnable mitigation by EOD.

carlos_se: Can someone paste their sanitized trace? I want to repro.

meera_cs: They sent `POST /v1/generate 256 tokens p95=460ms tail=900ms` from a VM inside their VPC to our Private relay. Burst pattern QPS ~10.

sanjay_ops: Ops can spin a 12h dedicated pool in their VPC and lock egress. Estimate delta ~$1.6k pre-credit. We'll need legal addendum for SSO and demo account.

carlos_se: Quick lab repro: baseline p95 ~460ms. With connection pooling + batch_window_ms=25 + min_replicas=2 -> p95 ~140-160ms. NVMe gives another ~10% improvement.

zoe_legal: I'll draft a minimal addendum to scope SSO demo access and BYO-KMS wording. Can review in 2h.

hayley_sales: Action list: @carlos_se validate numbers with canary and upload trace link; @sanjay_ops prepare cost + ops runbook; @zoe_legal draft addendum; @meera_cs finalize sec questionnaire answers. I'll craft exec note after numbers.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-3333337777 created. Canary queued id `canary-3333337777-01`.

carlos_se: Canary results uploaded: https://redwood-internal/trace/3333337777  p95 dropped to 148ms with batch_window_ms=25 and min_replicas=2; NVMe -> 132ms.

sanjay_ops: Cost breakdown posted internally. With a 20% POC credit net ~ $1,120 for 12h. Ready to proceed on ops sign-off and signed addendum.

hayley_sales: Thanks team. I'll send the exec paragraph to Head of Sales and the Apollo execs in 30m. If approved we'll do canary -> controlled rollout for the demo window. :thumbsup:
